photos.title: Twilight Field Car
photos.caption: A wide, low-angle shot captures an old, rusty, olive-green sedan partially submerged in a field of tall, vibrant green grass. Above, the twilight sky transitions from a warm orange-red at the horizon to a deep indigo overhead, filled with countless stars and a prominent bright celestial object. The scene evokes a serene and nostalgic mood of abandonment under the vast night sky.

photos.title: Rusty Car Starlight
photos.caption: A wide, low-angle shot of a heavily rusted, abandoned classic car in a dark field at night. The car's orange-brown hood and fenders contrast with its reflective chrome bumper, and its left headlight is intact while the right is a dark, empty socket. Above the silhouetted bare trees in the background, a deep blue sky twinkles with numerous white stars, casting an eerie yet serene atmosphere.

photos.title: Rusty Car Night
photos.caption: A wide shot of a rusty, abandoned 1950s-era car with a shattered windshield, parked in a field of dry grass under a dark blue, star-filled night sky. The car is two-toned, with a rusted brown front and a faded white and blue rear. Bare trees line the background, and the dark, gnarled shadow of a tree branch stretches across the foreground grass.

photos.title: Steel Wool Car Sparks
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph captures an orange Dodge Challenger parked on a gravel road at night, illuminated by a shower of bright, golden sparks from steel wool spinning. The sparks arc over the car and rain down around it, creating a dramatic light trail effect. In the background, a dark train car and a tall, rustic water tower are visible under a cloudy night sky, also touched by the golden light of the sparks.

photos.title: Rusty Fleetwood Stars
photos.caption: A rusty, vintage Cadillac Fleetwood car is parked in a field of dry grass, viewed from its rear under a dark blue, star-filled night sky. Silhouettes of bare trees and dark evergreens frame the scene, with a faint glow on the horizon. The image conveys a mood of peaceful abandonment.

photos.title: Rusty Car Under Stars
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph taken at night shows a rusty, abandoned car in a field of dry grass under a dark blue sky filled with countless stars. In the background, silhouetted trees and a couple of dilapidated buildings are visible, with a faint glow of light pollution on the horizon to the right. The overall mood is one of serene desolation.

photos.title: Rusty Car Under Stars
photos.caption: An old, rusted brown sedan, possibly from the 1940s or 50s, sits abandoned in a field of dry grass and leaves. Tall, bare trees with gnarled branches frame the car and extend into a deep blue, star-filled night sky. The entire scene is bathed in a warm, golden light, creating a mysterious and nostalgic atmosphere.

photos.title: Riverside Stargazing
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph captures a serene night landscape featuring a vibrant starry sky above dark, silhouetted mountains. In the foreground, a river flows smoothly over rocks, its water appearing milky white, while a dark car with bright headlights illuminates a dirt road and nearby trees on the right. A tall evergreen tree stands prominently on the left, reaching towards the vast, star-filled expanse.

photos.title: Old Trucks in Shed
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light photograph shows two rusty, antique trucks parked inside a dilapidated wooden shed. The shed's roof is partially collapsed, and several bare tree trunks act as support beams within the structure. The ground is covered in a thick layer of autumn leaves, illuminated by a warm, orange light, creating a mysterious and nostalgic mood. Bare tree branches are visible against the dark, cloudy night sky above the shed.

photos.title: Rusty Car Under Stars
photos.caption: A wide-angle night photograph captures a rusty, abandoned 1950s-era sedan with its doors open, sitting in a field of dry, golden-orange grass. The car and foreground are illuminated by a warm light, contrasting with the vast, dark night sky densely populated with countless white stars. The scene evokes a mood of desolate beauty and the passage of time.

photos.title: Rusty Plymouth Under Stars
photos.caption: A low-angle, wide shot captures a heavily rusted, vintage Plymouth car, likely from the 1940s, partially obscured by tall green foliage in the foreground. The car's front grille, headlights, and the 'PLYMOUTH' emblem are visible, all showing significant signs of decay. Above, the night sky is filled with numerous faint stars, with a subtle gradient of light pollution near the horizon, suggesting a rural or semi-rural setting. The overall mood is one of nostalgic abandonment and the passage of time.

photos.title: Rusty Truck Under Stars
photos.caption: A wide-angle, long-exposure photograph taken at night shows a rusty, abandoned vintage International truck and a large, spherical metal object under a clear, star-filled dark blue sky. The truck, positioned on the right, is heavily corroded with a broken windshield and an open driver's door, and a dark glass jug rests on its passenger-side fender. To the left, a dome-shaped, rusty metal object with a circular opening is partially buried in a dense pile of tangled wires and debris, creating a desolate and nostalgic mood.

photos.title: Rusting Car Graveyard Night
photos.caption: A low-angle, wide shot captures a rusty, partially disassembled vintage car in the foreground, its chrome grille still somewhat intact, surrounded by dry grass. In the midground, more dilapidated vehicles are visible. Above, a bare-branched tree frames the left side of the image, while the deep blue night sky, dotted with faint stars and streaky clouds, fills the upper right, creating a somber and atmospheric scene.

photos.title: Cadillac Ranch Night Sky
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light shot of the Cadillac Ranch art installation at night. Several graffiti-covered car bodies are half-buried nose-down in a field of dry grass and dirt, stretching from the left foreground towards the right background. The sky above is a deep black, filled with countless tiny white stars, with a subtle purple and orange glow from light pollution on the horizon. In the background, a few rustic buildings with blue and purple hues are visible under the dark sky.

photos.title: Forgotten Roadside Relics
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light photograph shows a desolate, abandoned gas station at night. Under a rusty metal canopy, two tall, orange-brown gas pumps with exposed mechanisms flank a heavily rusted, dark 1940s sedan, all surrounded by dry grass and bare trees. The crumbling concrete building behind them and the deep blue, star-speckled sky create an eerie, forgotten atmosphere.

photos.title: Neon Junkyard Night
photos.caption: A wide-angle, long-exposure photograph captures a heavily rusted, two-tone classic car, possibly a 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air, abandoned in a field at night. Its shattered windshield glows with vibrant red and blue light from within, and a green light illuminates the dry grass near its rear. In the background, under a starry sky with a bright moon, several other dark, silhouetted abandoned trucks and bare trees create an eerie, nostalgic atmosphere.

photos.title: Starry Night Farm Machines
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light photograph captures several large, rusted farming machines, possibly combines, partially buried and tilted in a field under a dark, star-filled night sky. The machines are illuminated with a purple and reddish hue, creating a surreal and eerie scene. Faint lights from a distant town are visible on the horizon, adding to the mysterious atmosphere.

photos.title: Graffiti Car Night
photos.caption: An old, rusted car body, heavily graffitied with colorful spray paint, sits in a grassy field at night. The car's interior and grille are illuminated with vibrant green, blue, and red lights, casting an eerie glow. In the background, a building with more graffiti and a dark, star-filled sky with faint power lines complete the scene.

photos.title: Bug Spiders at Night
photos.caption: Four Volkswagen Beetle shells, painted orange and black, are arranged in a grassy field under a starry night sky. They are modified to resemble spiders, with black metal 'legs' extending from their sides. The interiors of the Beetles are lit with different colors: the smallest, furthest one is red, the next is green, the third is blue, and the largest, closest one is red. The horizon shows a faint glow of light pollution.

photos.title: Rusting Car in Bushes
photos.caption: A rusty, dark orange vintage car is almost completely overgrown by dense, bare, reddish-brown bushes and branches. The car's front grille and a single headlight are visible, with a broken windshield revealing a dark interior. The background shows a dark blue night sky with faint stars and more bare trees, suggesting a desolate, forgotten setting.

photos.title: Night Light Painting Car
photos.caption: A wide-angle, long-exposure photograph captures a rusty, two-tone blue and brown vintage car in a field at night. The moon glows brightly in the upper left, illuminating bare trees and a starry sky. Two blurred figures, one on the left with an orange light trail and one on the right with a white and blue light trail, appear to be 'light painting' the car. The car's interior is lit with a vibrant red glow, and its hood reflects a bright white light, creating a surreal and artistic scene.

photos.title: Rusty Truck Under Stars
photos.caption: A rusty, vintage truck with a red-lit grille and interior sits in a field of dry grass under a star-filled night sky. Bare tree branches hang from the top, and a large tree trunk stands on the right, illuminated by a warm light. In the background, a dense line of leafless trees creates a dark silhouette against the blue night.

photos.title: Abandoned Car Interior Night
photos.caption: The interior of an old, rusted car is seen from a wide-angle perspective, looking out through the windshield at a dark forest illuminated by an unseen light source. The steering wheel, dashboard with gauges and radio, and the bare metal springs of the front seat are visible, all showing signs of heavy decay and rust. The mood is eerie and desolate.

photos.title: Night Sky Truck
photos.caption: A vintage gold Chevrolet pickup truck is parked on a dirt road at night, facing slightly right. To its left stands a rusty, old gas pump with a glowing blue light in its display. In the background, a windmill with blurred blades stands tall against a dark blue sky filled with numerous stars. A small shed and a covered structure are also visible, suggesting a rural or abandoned setting.

photos.title: Rusty Car Night
photos.caption: A rusty, vintage car with a shattered windshield, illuminated by a blue light from within, sits abandoned amidst dry, tangled bushes under a starry night sky. The car's front grille and bumper are still somewhat shiny, contrasting with its otherwise weathered, reddish-brown body. The overall mood is eerie and nostalgic.

photos.title: Abandoned Desert Van
photos.caption: An abandoned, rusty white panel van with its driver's door open sits on a rocky desert landscape under a clear, star-filled night sky. The van's rear windows are covered with a bright green material, and its weathered body shows extensive rust and peeling paint. Sparse desert bushes and distant lights are visible on the horizon, illuminated by the night.

photos.title: Rusty Truck Under Stars
photos.caption: An old, rusty, red flatbed truck with a wooden bed sits abandoned on a dirt path, surrounded by dry grass and brush. The truck faces slightly left, with its front wheels partially obscured by tall grass. In the background, rolling hills rise under a dark blue night sky filled with numerous bright stars. The scene evokes a sense of solitude and the passage of time.

photos.title: Rusty Car Under Night Sky
photos.caption: An old, rusty, orange-brown car sits abandoned in a field under a dark blue night sky filled with many stars. Bare trees with intricate branches frame the scene, some casting shadows on the car and the dry, grassy ground. The overall mood is one of quiet solitude and decay.

photos.title: Rusty Car Under Stars
photos.caption: A low-angle, wide shot captures a rusty, teal-colored vintage car, partially obscured by tall green and brown weeds, under a starry, light-polluted night sky. The car's front is illuminated by an unseen light source, highlighting its single visible headlight and the extensive rust on its hood and fenders. The sky above is a warm, hazy orange-brown, dotted with numerous faint, slightly blurred stars, suggesting a long exposure or atmospheric conditions. In the distance, faint power lines and dark silhouettes of trees are visible against the glowing horizon.

photos.title: Haunted Graveyard Night
photos.caption: A wide, dark, and eerie nighttime shot of a graveyard with a dilapidated, gothic-style house in the background. The sky is a deep teal-green, filled with countless bright white stars. In the foreground, to the left, stands a large, ornate stone cross and a weathered tombstone. Bare, skeletal trees are scattered throughout the scene, their branches reaching towards the starry sky. A metal fence runs across the midground, separating the graveyard from the distant, faintly lit horizon.

photos.title: Shadow of Christ Cathedral
photos.caption: A dramatic nighttime view of the St. Louis Cathedral in New Orleans, featuring a large shadow of a figure with outstretched arms projected onto its white facade. In the foreground, a brightly illuminated white statue of Jesus with open arms stands on a pedestal, surrounded by dark trees and a tall stone monument. The scene is set under a dark, cloudy sky, with other historic buildings visible to the right.

photos.title: First Presbyterian Church Night
photos.caption: A grand, illuminated stone church at night, featuring a classical facade with four large fluted columns and ornate Corinthian capitals. Above the columns, the words 'FIRST PRESBYTERIAN CHURCH' are inscribed in gold letters. The central entrance has a large wooden double door with a stained glass transom depicting an angel, and above it, the inscription 'GOD IS LIGHT'. Flanking the entrance are two large arched windows with intricate stained glass, and two smaller stained glass windows are visible on the lower level, one on each side. The warm yellow light highlights the architectural details and the vibrant colors of the stained glass.

photos.title: Nin Churches Dusk
photos.caption: A long exposure shot at dusk shows two stone buildings and a stone bridge over a river. On the left, a tall, slender bell tower with a pointed roof and arched openings is illuminated from within, casting a warm glow against the fading light. To the right, a smaller, single-story stone church with a red tile roof and a cross on its bell-gable stands on a grassy mound, surrounded by a pile of white rocks. The river flows under the arched bridge, its surface smoothed by the long exposure, reflecting the dim light of the sky.

photos.title: Fort Worth Skyline Night
photos.caption: A nighttime cityscape features two tall, dark skyscrapers with numerous illuminated windows and red lights on their roofs, flanking a cluster of smaller buildings. In the foreground, a prominent white gothic-style church with multiple spires is brightly lit, surrounded by dark trees. Other buildings, including a light brown one and a pale green one with a parking garage, are also visible, all under a dark blue night sky.

photos.title: Night Lit Courtyard
photos.caption: A nighttime photo of a building's courtyard, illuminated by various lights. The building on the left has large windows and a brick facade, with a tree in front whose leaves are brightly lit in yellow-green. Another tree to its right is adorned with purple string lights. The courtyard features stone benches and a patterned tiled ground, with shadows of trees cast across it. To the right, an arched walkway with columns leads further into the building's structure, with more trees and greenery visible.

photos.title: Illuminated Crosses Night Sky
photos.caption: A large, brilliantly glowing white cross stands prominently on a dark, grassy hill under a deep blue, star-filled night sky. To its right, three smaller, darker crosses depicting crucified figures are visible, creating a dramatic and spiritual scene.

photos.title: Saint Olaf Church
photos.caption: A historic, light-colored stone church with a dark shingled roof and a tall, ornate wooden steeple topped by a cross stands in a vast, dry field. A curving gravel path leads to its arched entrance, and a small cemetery gate is visible to the right, with distant rolling hills under a soft, overcast sky.

photos.title: Rural Church at Dusk
photos.caption: A low-angle, wide shot of a small, white wooden church at dusk. The sky is a deep twilight blue with faint clouds. The church has a simple steeple with a white cross on top. The front door is open, revealing a warm, golden light emanating from within, illuminating an altar with a cross. Dark green trees frame the church on both sides, and a grassy field fills the foreground.

photos.title: Moonlit Desert Chapel
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph of an old, dilapidated chapel at night, with a bright full moon directly behind the cross on its roof, creating a strong halo effect. Streaky clouds appear to radiate from the moon across the dark sky, which is dotted with faint stars. The chapel's stucco walls are peeling, revealing a mesh underneath, and its wooden doors and window frames are weathered. Dry grass and sand cover the ground in front of the building, with dark hills visible in the background.

photos.title: Church Under Stars
photos.caption: A white church with a dark green steeple stands on a grassy hill under a vast, dark blue night sky filled with countless bright stars. A faint, wispy cloud formation is visible near the horizon on the left, and a few prominent stars or planets appear as streaks due to long exposure, particularly one bright streak in the upper left and another near the top center.

photos.title: Church Under Stars
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light photograph captures a stone church with a white steeple and cross under a dark, star-filled night sky. The church is illuminated by a warm light, casting shadows on the surrounding dark ground and a wooden picket fence in the foreground. To the right, a large, bare tree trunk with branches extends into the upper right corner, and a small house with a white picket fence is visible behind the church.

photos.title: Abandoned Church Night Sky
photos.caption: An old, weathered wooden church stands under a dark, star-filled night sky. The church has a tall, square bell tower and a front entrance with steps and a handrail. The wooden siding is faded and worn, with some areas appearing lighter than others due to light exposure. In the distance, on the left, there's a faint glow of light pollution, and on the right, a cluster of bright red lights is visible against the dark horizon.

photos.title: Abandoned Church Night
photos.caption: An old, dilapidated church stands under a starry night sky. The church's facade is weathered, with peeling plaster revealing the underlying structure. Red light emanates from its windows and open doorway, casting an eerie glow. The church is surrounded by sandy ground with sparse dry grass and a few pieces of driftwood, with dark hills rising in the background on either side.

photos.title: Starry Night Church
photos.caption: A small, reddish-brown stone church with a white door and a steeple topped with a white cross stands prominently under a vast, star-filled night sky. A narrow path leads from the foreground directly to the church's arched entrance, flanked by sparse, dark ground. The deep teal-blue sky above is densely populated with countless bright, twinkling stars, creating a serene and majestic atmosphere.

photos.title: Chaco Canyon Night Sky
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph of the Pueblo Bonito ruins at Chaco Culture National Historical Park under a clear, star-filled night sky. The ancient stone walls are illuminated with a warm, orange light, highlighting their intricate construction and casting deep shadows. The dark blue sky above is densely populated with countless tiny white stars.

photos.title: Ruined Church Under Stars
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light shot of a crumbling, light-colored church under a dark, star-filled night sky. The church's front entrance features a prominent red archway, and a cross is visible atop its bell tower. The right side of the sky is illuminated by an orange glow, likely from light pollution, while the left side reveals numerous stars. Bare branches and shrubs are visible in the foreground, lit by the same warm light illuminating the church.

photos.title: Red Doorway Stars
photos.caption: A long-exposure photograph captures the ruins of a building at night, with a prominent central archway glowing red. Through the red-outlined doorway, dark mountains are visible, while the dark sky above is filled with numerous stars. A faint orange glow from distant light pollution illuminates clouds on the left horizon, adding to the mysterious and desolate atmosphere.

photos.title: Moonlit Church and Ruin
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph taken at night shows a dirt road leading towards a small, white church with a dome-shaped steeple, nestled among dark trees in the distance. To the left, a brick building heavily overgrown with dark green ivy and vines stands partially obscured by tall grass, its windows dark and empty. The sky above is a deep indigo, streaked with faint, wispy clouds and dotted with numerous stars, suggesting a moonlit night.

photos.title: Desert Night Church
photos.caption: A nighttime photo shows a small, rustic stone church with a white picket fence on the left, and a dilapidated yellow adobe building with a corrugated metal roof on the right. The dark sky above is filled with countless bright stars, and a faint glow from the horizon suggests distant light pollution. The overall mood is serene and slightly melancholic, highlighting the quiet beauty of an abandoned or remote settlement under a starry sky.

photos.title: Milky Way Church Night
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph captures a dimly lit brick church with a tall steeple and cross under a vast, star-filled night sky. The faint, cloudy band of the Milky Way stretches across the upper right, while countless stars appear as short trails across the dark expanse. A dark tree is partially visible on the left, and the church's windows glow faintly.

photos.title: Tufa Steel Wool Night
photos.caption: A long-exposure photograph captures a dramatic night scene with tall, textured tufa formations under a dark, star-filled sky. Bright orange and yellow light trails, created by spinning burning steel wool, arc dynamically across the sky and cascade down, illuminating the rock pillars. A central burst of sparks glows intensely among the formations, casting a warm, fiery light on the surrounding landscape, creating an artistic and otherworldly effect.

photos.title: Stars Through Rocks
photos.caption: A low-angle night photograph captures a dark teal sky filled with numerous white stars, framed by two massive, dark grey rock formations on the left and right. In the center, a tall, slender, reddish-brown rock stands illuminated by a warm light, with smaller rocks scattered on the gravelly ground below. The scene creates a dramatic natural archway to the cosmos.

photos.title: Night Sky Boulders
photos.caption: A wide-angle, long-exposure photograph captures a dark night sky filled with countless stars, transitioning to a deep purple-red glow near the horizon. In the foreground, large, light-colored boulders with prominent horizontal striations are scattered across a vibrant green grassy field, illuminated by an unseen light source. Behind the boulders, a line of dark green trees forms a natural boundary, with some trees brightly lit and others receding into shadow.

photos.title: Night Sky Hoodoos
photos.caption: A wide-angle, long-exposure shot captures a dark night sky filled with countless stars, above a desert landscape. In the foreground, several unique rock formations, known as hoodoos, are illuminated with vibrant red, blue, and orange lights, creating a striking contrast against the dark surroundings. The overall mood is magical and serene.

photos.title: Mountain Night Sky
photos.caption: A wide shot of a rugged mountain landscape at night, illuminated by a faint light source. The sky above is a deep blue, partially obscured by soft, wispy clouds, with numerous stars visible through the clear patches. The mountains are composed of large, textured rock formations in shades of brown and gray, with some areas covered in dark green trees. A distinctive rock formation with a natural arch or hole is visible on the left side of the image. In the foreground, several bare, light-colored trees stand out against the darker, rocky terrain.

photos.title: Starry Night Rock Formations
photos.caption: A wide-angle, long-exposure photograph captures a dark night sky densely populated with countless white stars, including the prominent Pleiades star cluster in the upper right. In the foreground, several large, rugged rock formations are visible, with a tall, reddish-brown rock standing vertically in the left-center, its left side subtly illuminated with purple and blue light. A faint glow of light pollution is visible on the distant horizon, adding to the serene and vast atmosphere.

photos.title: Starry Night Rock
photos.caption: A mushroom-shaped rock formation stands prominently in a grassy field under a dark, star-filled night sky. The rock has a wide, dark brown cap balanced on a narrower, lighter yellowish-brown pedestal, illuminated against the darkness. Dark silhouettes of trees and bushes line the horizon behind the formation, and a smaller rock lies in the illuminated foreground grass.

photos.title: Moonlit Boulders, Streaky Sky
photos.caption: A long-exposure night photograph captures a landscape of towering, weathered rock formations and dry, golden-brown grass under a deep blue sky. The rocks and foreground are bathed in a warm, orange light, while the sky above features countless tiny star trails and elongated, streaky white clouds, indicating their movement during the exposure.

photos.title: Black Canyon Night Sky
photos.caption: A long exposure shot of the Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park at night, with a deep canyon winding through the center, illuminated by the distant lights of a town on the horizon. The sky above is a deep blue, filled with numerous stars and streaky white clouds, indicating their movement during the exposure. Large, rugged rocks in the foreground show some green lichen, adding texture to the scene.

photos.title: Starry Desert Hoodoos
photos.caption: A wide shot of a desert landscape at night, featuring several tall, orange-red hoodoo rock formations under a dark blue, starry sky with wispy, illuminated clouds. The two largest hoodoos dominate the right side, while a smaller one stands further left amidst sandy terrain and sparse desert plants. A canyon is visible in the mid-ground, all bathed in soft, ethereal light.

photos.title: Stars and Hoodoos
photos.caption: A night photograph captures a vast, dark blue sky filled with countless white stars above a desert landscape. Tall, eroded rock formations, including a prominent central pillar, glow with a warm, yellowish-brown light, contrasting with the cool tones of the starry sky. The foreground consists of gravelly ground with a few small, round green bushes, adding to the serene and mysterious atmosphere.

photos.title: Milky Way Badlands Night
photos.caption: A wide-angle, vertical shot of a dark night sky filled with countless stars and the glowing band of the Milky Way, stretching diagonally from the lower right to the upper left. Below the starry sky, a dark silhouette of rolling hills or mountains forms the horizon. In the foreground, a barren, sandy landscape is dotted with numerous light-colored, irregularly shaped rock formations, resembling fossilized shells or strange alien eggs, illuminated faintly by the starlight.

photos.title: Balanced Rock Night Rays
photos.caption: A dramatic long-exposure photograph captures a towering, dark rock formation in silhouette against a glowing night sky. Distinct radial light rays emanate from behind the balanced rock, illuminating the clouds in warm orange and brown tones. The sky transitions to a darker purplish-blue on the left, revealing faint stars above silhouetted gnarled trees and sparse desert vegetation in the foreground.

photos.title: Starry Desert Hoodoo
photos.caption: A breathtaking night photograph captures a vast, dark blue sky densely populated with countless white stars over a desert landscape. In the foreground, a prominent, light-colored hoodoo rock formation, resembling a mushroom with a reddish cap, is illuminated by a warm glow, standing amidst other eroded sandstone formations. Behind it, darker cliffs rise, their upper sections also catching the warm light, creating a dramatic and serene scene.

photos.title: Stars Over Rocks
photos.caption: A vertical night photograph showcases a dark sky densely populated with countless stars. In the lower half, a landscape is illuminated by a warm, orange light, highlighting two large, rounded, reddish-brown boulders with textured surfaces. Green trees stand in the mid-ground, and blade-like plants are visible in the immediate foreground, all casting soft shadows under the starry expanse.

photos.title: Goblin Valley Night Sky
photos.caption: A dramatic night landscape showcases unique reddish-brown rock formations under a dark, starry sky with illuminated clouds. A tall, balanced rock with a large, round top stands prominently on the right, while several squat, mushroom-shaped hoodoos are visible on the left. The scene, likely moonlit, highlights the otherworldly shapes of the rocks against the celestial backdrop.

photos.title: Orange Rock Star Trails
photos.caption: A long exposure night photograph captures a massive, rugged sandstone rock formation illuminated with a warm orange glow. Above the formation, the dark blue sky shows faint star trails and streaky clouds, transitioning to an orange hue at the top. The foreground is a rocky desert landscape.

photos.title: Arches National Park Night Sky
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph captures a starry night sky over a large rock formation in Arches National Park. The formation features a tall, dark spire on the left and a massive arch in the center, through which a lighter, star-filled sky is visible. Wispy clouds streak across the dark blue sky, illuminated slightly by an unseen light source, creating a sense of movement against the static stars. The rocks themselves are dimly lit with a reddish-purple hue, contrasting with the deep shadows at their base.

photos.title: Shiprock Meteor Night
photos.caption: A majestic, dark, jagged mountain, likely Shiprock, is silhouetted against a vast, deep blue night sky filled with countless tiny white stars. A brilliant white-blue meteor streaks diagonally across the upper right portion of the sky. A faint orange glow from distant light pollution is visible along the horizon on the right, and a 'TWILIGHTSCAPES.COM' watermark is in the bottom right.

photos.title: Star Trails Over Butte
photos.caption: A long-exposure photograph captures star trails streaking diagonally across a dark night sky, with a tall, slender rock formation (butte) silhouetted against the celestial backdrop. The star trails appear as numerous parallel lines, predominantly blue and white, with some faint reddish and purple hues, indicating the Earth's rotation. The butte is a stark, dark silhouette, dominating the lower center of the frame, with a smaller, rounded hill forming its base. A watermark for 'TWILIGHTSCAPES.com' with a logo of mountains, a moon, and stars is visible in the bottom right corner.

photos.title: Desert Night Sky Sinkhole
photos.caption: A wide-angle night photograph captures a vast desert landscape under a starry sky. In the foreground, reddish-brown sandstone formations show intricate patterns, with a large, dark, circular depression revealing green vegetation at its base. A distant, layered mountain range stretches across the midground, silhouetted against a dark blue sky filled with countless stars, while a faint orange glow appears on the left horizon.

photos.title: Night Sky Rocks
photos.caption: A dark night sky filled with countless white stars stretches above a landscape of large, light brown rock formations and dry, golden-brown grass. A prominent, tall, and somewhat irregularly shaped rock stands on the right, while several smaller, rounded rocks are visible in the mid-ground on the left. The overall mood is serene and majestic, highlighting the vastness of the cosmos against an earthly scene.

photos.title: Milky Way Desert Night
photos.caption: A wide-angle night photograph captures a vast, dark blue sky filled with countless stars and the glowing band of the Milky Way stretching diagonally across the upper right. In the foreground, a large, rounded, light-colored rock formation with textured surfaces is illuminated. To its right, a small figure in red stands between the rock and tall, rugged cliffs, using a light source to illuminate parts of the cliffs in green and white. A warm orange glow from a distant light source is visible on the far left horizon.

photos.title: Stars and Stone Night
photos.caption: A wide-angle night photograph captures a majestic, dark rock formation silhouetted against a deep indigo sky teeming with countless bright stars. The tall, layered rock occupies the lower half of the frame, while a faint meteor streak is visible in the upper starry expanse. The scene evokes a sense of ancient grandeur under a vast celestial canvas.

photos.title: Desert Concretions Twilight
photos.caption: A wide shot of a desolate, otherworldly desert landscape at twilight. In the foreground, numerous large, rounded, and cracked reddish-brown rock concretions, some resembling petrified eggs, are scattered across the light-colored sandy ground, with smaller hoodoo formations visible in the midground. The sky transitions from a warm orange glow on the left horizon to a dark purple-grey, casting long shadows and creating an ancient, mysterious mood.

photos.title: Starry Desert Pillar
photos.caption: A wide-angle night photograph captures a vast, star-filled sky over a desert landscape. A tall, slender, light brown rock pillar stands prominently in the mid-ground, illuminated by a brilliant, almost glowing full moon on the right. The foreground features a dark, rounded rock with vertical striations, while the left background shows reddish-brown hills under a deep indigo sky with subtle purple hues and faint clouds.

photos.title: Orion Over Desert Mesa
photos.caption: A wide-angle night photograph captures a towering, reddish-brown rock formation (mesa or butte) on the right, rising against a dark, star-filled sky. The constellation Orion is visible in the upper center-left, alongside a bright star in the upper left, with wispy clouds drifting across the sky. The rugged foreground is a reddish-brown desert landscape, scattered with rocks and sparse vegetation, softly illuminated by ambient light.

photos.title: Red Dragon Rock Night
photos.caption: A dramatic night photograph captures a large, naturally sculpted rock formation, illuminated with a vibrant red light, resembling a dragon's head and neck. The crimson rock, with its intricate textures and an eye-like hole, stands out against a deep blue, star-filled night sky.

photos.title: Canyonlands Starry Night
photos.caption: A wide-angle night photograph captures a vast, rugged canyon landscape under a dark, star-filled sky. The reddish-brown rock formations of the canyon are illuminated by a faint light source, creating deep shadows and highlighting the intricate geological features, with distant mountains visible on the horizon. The bottom right corner features a logo with a mountain, moon, and stars, and the text 'TWILIGHTSCAPES.COM'.

photos.title: Night Sky with Boulders
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light photograph captures a starry night sky above a landscape featuring large boulders and trees. The boulders and some foliage are illuminated by an unseen light source, casting a warm glow on the foreground and creating deep shadows. The overall mood is mysterious and serene.

photos.title: Starry Night Bare Tree
photos.caption: A long-exposure night photograph reveals a dark blue sky filled with numerous star trails and soft, orange-pink clouds. A large, gnarled, bare tree with intricate branches stands prominently in the foreground, while a dark, cylindrical tower and a low building are visible on the right. The foreground field of dry grass is illuminated with a warm, orange glow, creating a mysterious and serene atmosphere.

photos.title: Ancient Tree Under Stars
photos.caption: A gnarled, ancient tree with some green foliage stands on reddish-brown rock formations and soil under a dark, star-filled night sky. The constellation Orion is visible in the upper right, while faint clouds drift across the left horizon. The desert landscape is dimly lit, creating a serene and majestic nocturnal scene.

photos.title: Moonlit Beach Branches
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light shot of a beach at dusk or dawn, framed by the dark, gnarled branches of a dead tree. The moon, a bright orb with a halo of light, is visible in the upper center of the deep blue sky, which transitions to a soft orange-pink at the horizon. In the midground, a sandy beach with sparse patches of grass leads to a body of water, beyond which city lights twinkle in the distance. Numerous wooden pilings and debris from what appears to be an old pier or structure are scattered across the sand and extending into the water on the right.

photos.title: Starburst Sunset Field
photos.caption: An expansive view of a field at sunset, dominated by the dark silhouette of a large, mature tree with intricate branches. The setting sun, visible as a bright starburst through the lower branches, illuminates the field's tall, dry grass with a rich, golden-orange light. The sky transitions from vibrant orange and yellow near the horizon to soft purplish-gray clouds higher up, creating a serene and picturesque landscape.

photos.title: Night Sky Tree Silhouette
photos.caption: A wide shot of a large, bare tree silhouetted against a dark night sky filled with numerous stars. The horizon glows with a warm yellow-orange light pollution, illuminating the dry, grassy foreground and distant bushes.

photos.title: Ancient Tree in Sunlight
photos.caption: A low-angle, dramatic shot of a massive, ancient tree with a thick, gnarled trunk and exposed roots, bathed in warm, golden sunlight that highlights its textured bark. The tree's dark green canopy fills the upper frame, contrasting with a lighter, hazy sky and a backdrop of other dark trees and lush green grass in a field, creating a somewhat mysterious and powerful mood.

photos.title: Dead Tree Lake
photos.caption: A desolate landscape features a large, gnarled dead tree with bare branches standing prominently on a dry, cracked dirt bank in the foreground. Behind it, a dark, still body of water stretches into the distance, dotted with numerous other skeletal trees submerged in the water. The sky above is a muted teal-green, with scattered white cumulus clouds, contributing to a somber and eerie mood.

photos.title: Milky Way Desert Night
photos.caption: A long-exposure night photograph showcases the Milky Way stretching across a dark blue sky, partially veiled by streaky, fast-moving clouds. In the foreground, a gnarled, bare tree with intricate branches is illuminated, standing against the silhouette of distant rock formations on a dark desert landscape. The scene evokes a sense of vastness and natural wonder.

photos.title: Dead Trees Sunset Reflection
photos.caption: A wide shot of a still body of water reflecting the orange and pink hues of a sunset sky. Several bare, dead trees with white bark stand in the water, their skeletal branches reaching upwards and casting dark, intricate reflections on the water's surface. The background features a dense line of dark, leafless bushes and reeds, with some lighter-colored cattails visible on the right side. The overall mood is serene and slightly melancholic.

photos.title: Solitary Lake Tree
photos.caption: A minimalist long-exposure photograph captures a solitary, bare tree standing in calm, blue-grey water. Its dark silhouette and reflection dominate the left side of the frame, while a distant, dark treeline separates the tranquil water from the muted blue sky above. The overall mood is serene and contemplative.

photos.title: Orion and Pines Night
photos.caption: A wide-angle, long-exposure photograph captures a dark blue night sky densely packed with stars, prominently featuring Orion's Belt and the Pleiades star cluster. In the foreground, several tall pine trees are brightly illuminated with a warm, golden-green light, contrasting with the deep blue sky. Low, streaky clouds on the left horizon glow faintly orange, creating a serene and majestic natural scene.

photos.title: Starry Canyon Night
photos.caption: A wide-angle night photograph captures a vast canyon landscape under a sky filled with countless stars and wispy clouds. In the foreground, reddish-brown earth is dotted with patches of snow and low bushes, while a large, gnarled, bare tree is silhouetted on the right. Distant canyon walls glow faintly, adding to the serene and majestic mood of the scene.

photos.title: Starry Night Trees
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light photograph captures the silhouette of several bare, gnarled trees against a vast, dark night sky filled with countless stars. The Milky Way is visible as a hazy band of light on the right side of the frame, and a faint glow of light pollution or dawn is visible near the horizon on the right. The overall mood is serene and majestic.

photos.title: Meteor Over Dead Tree
photos.caption: A wide-angle night photograph captures a dark sky densely populated with stars, including a bright meteor streaking diagonally downwards in the upper left. A large, gnarled dead tree with bare, twisted branches stands prominently in the center, its trunk and branches appearing dark blue. To the right, more silhouetted dead trees and branches frame a calm body of water, with a faint glow on the distant horizon.

photos.title: Grand Teton Autumn Landscape
photos.caption: A wide shot of the Grand Teton mountain range under a blue sky with scattered white clouds. The rugged, grey peaks are partially snow-capped, with the tallest peak, Grand Teton, prominent in the center. In the foreground, a vast field of golden-brown grass stretches out, with three vibrant orange-leafed trees standing tall, and a line of golden and green trees further back, indicating autumn foliage.

photos.title: Moulton Barn Sunset
photos.caption: A wide shot of a rustic wooden barn with a metal roof, set against a dramatic sunset sky. The sky is a blend of soft pinks, purples, and blues, with clouds streaking across. In the background, majestic mountains with hints of snow are visible, bathed in purple light. The foreground features a field of dry grass, with a few trees displaying vibrant yellow autumn foliage.

photos.title: Grand Teton Autumn Swan
photos.caption: A wide landscape captures a serene autumn scene with majestic, snow-dusted purple mountains under a soft, cloudy sky. A vibrant band of golden and orange fall foliage lines the middle ground, reflected in the calm, dark water of a lake. A lone white swan glides across the lower right of the lake, leaving a subtle ripple trail.

photos.title: Golden River Dawn
photos.caption: A breathtaking sunrise illuminates a misty river landscape. The sky is a dramatic blend of deep orange, yellow, and purple clouds, with the sun bursting intensely from the right, casting bright rays and long shadows from silhouetted evergreen trees. A thin layer of mist hovers over the land and water, which reflects the vibrant golden light, while several ducks swim calmly in the foreground.

photos.title: Canyonlands Overlook
photos.caption: A dramatic panoramic view of a vast canyon landscape under a partly cloudy sky. On the left, a massive, reddish-brown cliff face drops sharply into the canyon, with smaller rock formations and sparse green vegetation in the foreground. The right side of the image reveals a sprawling, arid terrain with winding paths and distant mesas under a mix of dark storm clouds and patches of blue sky.

photos.title: Winter Horse Landscape
photos.caption: A wide shot of a snowy winter landscape under a cloudy sky. In the foreground, a partially frozen stream winds through snow-covered ground with bare bushes. A dark horse grazes in a snow-covered field in the midground, behind a wire fence. In the background, a large hill covered in snow-dusted evergreen trees rises against the horizon.

photos.title: Alert Deer in Snow
photos.caption: An alert brown deer stands in a snow-covered landscape, looking directly at the viewer. Snow dusts the pine trees, green bushes, and tall golden grasses that emerge from the white ground, with distant mountains under a partly cloudy blue sky. A second deer is partially visible behind the main subject.

photos.title: Desert Mountains Landscape
photos.caption: A wide-angle landscape shot captures rolling, multi-colored desert hills in the foreground, ranging from light beige to deep reddish-brown. In the midground, a flat mesa stretches across the horizon, topped by a few dark, rocky formations. Far in the distance, a range of majestic, snow-capped mountains rises against a light blue sky with wispy white clouds.

photos.title: White Horse Desert
photos.caption: A white horse stands alone on a rocky, arid hillside under a clear blue sky. Behind the horse, a large, layered rock formation rises, casting shadows. The ground is covered in small, reddish-brown rocks and sparse dry grass, suggesting a desert or badlands environment.

photos.title: Desert Oasis Stream
photos.caption: A vibrant autumn landscape featuring a winding stream bed through a desert canyon. The foreground shows a dry, sandy stream path surrounded by green and yellow grasses and shrubs. In the midground, a cluster of tall trees with green and golden-yellow leaves stands beside the stream, with a single prominent tree displaying bright yellow foliage. The background reveals majestic, layered red rock formations and mesas under a dramatic sky filled with fluffy white clouds against a deep blue sky.

photos.title: Desert Mountain Landscape
photos.caption: A wide-angle shot of a vast desert landscape under a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the foreground, reddish-brown earth is covered with sparse, dry brush and a few small, green trees. The midground features a long range of layered, light-colored sandstone mountains with dark, horizontal striations and rounded tops. The mountains are covered in patches of dark green vegetation, and the overall scene conveys a sense of rugged natural beauty.

photos.title: Autumn Mountain Landscape
photos.caption: A wide landscape shot captures a vast, rolling terrain under a partly cloudy blue sky. In the foreground, dry, golden-brown grass covers a gentle slope, leading up to hillsides adorned with patches of vibrant yellow and orange aspen trees, interspersed with bare deciduous trees and dark green evergreens. In the midground, a dark blue mountain range stretches across the horizon, with a faint, hazy valley visible below it. The overall mood is serene and picturesque, showcasing the beauty of autumn in a mountainous region.

photos.title: Valley of the Gods Sunset
photos.caption: A panoramic desert landscape at sunset features a sky ablaze with orange, pink, and purple clouds, streaked with blue. Prominent red rock mesas flank the scene, with two distinct, dark red rock formations rising from the vast, scrub-covered plain in the middle ground. Distant blue mountains are visible under the colorful sky, adding depth to the serene and majestic view.

photos.title: Red Rock Desert Vista
photos.caption: A wide-angle view of a vast desert landscape under a brilliant blue sky with wispy white clouds. Towering red rock formations and a prominent slender rock spire dominate the scene, while the foreground is covered in reddish-orange sand and sparse desert vegetation.

photos.title: Sunflower Sunset Field
photos.caption: A wide shot of a vast sunflower field at sunset. The sky transitions from dark blue and purple at the top, with scattered dark clouds, to a vibrant orange and red horizon. The sunflowers in the foreground are brightly lit by the setting sun, their yellow petals glowing against the darker green foliage, while those further back appear as a golden carpet stretching to the distant tree line.

photos.title: Lone Tree in Water
photos.caption: A minimalist long-exposure photograph captures a solitary, bare tree silhouetted against a serene, muted blue sky and calm water. The tree, with its gnarled branches, stands in the middle-left of the frame, casting a soft, elongated reflection on the smooth, almost ethereal surface of the water, which transitions from a light blue-green near the horizon to a pale, creamy blue in the foreground. A dark, distant landmass forms a thin strip along the horizon, separating the sky from the water.

photos.title: Arches Desert Landscape
photos.caption: A wide-angle shot of a desert landscape under a partly cloudy sky. In the foreground, sparse green and brown desert shrubs grow on reddish-brown soil. The midground features a large, gnarled dead tree with many branches, and behind it, a series of massive, orange-red sandstone rock formations rise dramatically, some appearing as rounded domes and others as sharp, angular peaks.

photos.title: Wishing Well in Autumn Field
photos.caption: A wide shot of a rustic wishing well made of stone and wood, standing in a sun-dappled field of tall green and golden grass. Lush green trees form a dense backdrop, with hints of bright yellow and orange foliage suggesting autumn. Sunlight filters through the leaves, creating patches of light and shadow across the field, and a winding dirt path is visible in the distance between trees on the right.

photos.title: Vulture on Building
photos.caption: A dark, ominous vulture stands atop a weathered brick building, silhouetted against a cloudy, sepia-toned sky. Overgrown green and brown foliage fills the foreground, partially obscuring the lower half of the building, which features dark, empty window frames. A metal ladder-like structure is visible on the far right of the roof.

photos.title: White Sands Desert Landscape
photos.caption: A wide landscape shot of the White Sands National Park features vast, undulating white gypsum dunes under a dramatic blue sky. The foreground shows intricate wind-blown ripple patterns on the sand, leading to a small dune covered in golden, dry grasses. In the distance, more dunes stretch towards a hazy horizon, with faint mountains visible beneath a band of darker clouds.

photos.title: Canyonlands Sunbeams
photos.caption: A vast, high-angle landscape shot of Canyonlands National Park, Utah, under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. Sunbeams pierce through the clouds on the left, illuminating parts of the reddish-brown desert floor, which is dotted with patches of snow and winding canyons. A prominent red rock cliff face dominates the right side of the frame, providing a stark contrast to the expansive valley below.

photos.title: Desert Windmill and Birds
photos.caption: A wide shot of a desert landscape under a cloudy sky, featuring a tall, rustic windmill on the right with a bird's nest visible on its platform. Two birds are in flight in the sky, one prominent on the left and another smaller one near the center. In the midground, a rusty, rectangular water tank is enclosed by a wire fence, surrounded by sparse, dry vegetation and sandy ground.

photos.title: Autumn Mountain Landscape
photos.caption: A wide shot of a vibrant autumn landscape featuring a field of bright orange-red foliage in the foreground. In the midground, a tall tree with dark orange and brown leaves stands prominently on the left, surrounded by lower, dense brush. Behind the trees and brush, a range of rugged, dark grey mountains with patches of snow rise under a cloudy, overcast sky. The overall mood is serene and majestic, highlighting the beauty of the changing seasons.

photos.title: Stormy Sunset Landscape
photos.caption: A wide-angle landscape shot at dusk shows a vast green field in the foreground, with scattered trees and rolling hills leading to a distant mountain range. The sky is dramatic, with dark, heavy storm clouds dominating the upper half, revealing patches of bright blue sky and a striking orange and yellow sunset glow along the horizon.

photos.title: Mossy Forest Waterfall
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph captures a wide, white waterfall cascading down a dark rock face on the left, with the water appearing smooth and ethereal. On the right, two thick, moss-covered tree trunks stand prominently, their branches, also heavily draped in moss, extend across the upper frame. The background reveals a dense forest of tall, slender trees, illuminated by a warm, golden light filtering through the canopy, suggesting either sunrise or sunset. The foreground features a rich, reddish-brown ground covered in fallen leaves, with some green ferns peeking through near the base of the waterfall.

photos.title: Dead Trees Sunset
photos.caption: A wide shot of a wetland at sunset, featuring several bare, skeletal trees standing in shallow water. Their stark, light-colored branches are reflected in the calm, dark water below. The sky is a gradient of warm orange and pink, casting a serene yet slightly eerie glow over the scene. Tall, dark reeds and bushes line the distant banks, and a few white-topped cattails are visible among them.

photos.title: Hay Bales Under Dramatic Sky
photos.caption: A wide-angle landscape photograph captures a vast, golden-brown harvested field dotted with several round hay bales. A prominent bale sits in the mid-ground, casting a shadow. In the distance, a dense line of green trees separates the field from hazy, blue-grey mountains. The sky above is a dramatic mix of deep blue patches, bright white cumulus clouds, and swirling, darker grey clouds, creating a dynamic interplay of light and shadow across the scene.

photos.title: Golden Aspen Hillside
photos.caption: A vibrant autumn landscape features a winding dirt road cutting through a dry, golden-brown grassy hillside. The road leads up towards a dense forest of brilliant golden-yellow aspen trees that crown the hill. Above, a bright blue sky is streaked with wispy white clouds.

photos.title: Sunlit Waterfall Forest
photos.caption: A majestic waterfall cascades down a dark, mossy cliff face, its smooth, light-colored water contrasting with the deep blues and greens of the surrounding rock. Golden sunbeams pierce through a misty, dense forest canopy above, casting a warm glow on the upper part of the scene and creating dramatic light rays. In the foreground, bare branches and vibrant green and yellow foliage frame the bottom of the image, adding depth to the serene, mystical landscape.

photos.title: Trillium Lake Sunset
photos.caption: A wide landscape shot of Trillium Lake at sunset, with a vibrant orange and amber sky reflecting on the calm water. A snow-capped mountain, likely Mount Hood, is visible in the distance, framed by dark green pine forests on either side of the lake. A fallen log floats in the foreground of the lake, and the mountain's reflection is visible in the water.

photos.title: Fisherman Statue at Dusk
photos.caption: A bronze statue of a bearded fisherman in a hat and coat stands in a boat, holding a fishing net. The statue is illuminated by warm light against a twilight sky with bands of dark blue, grey, and pale yellow clouds. In the background, across the water, industrial buildings are silhouetted on the left, and dark trees line the right shore.

photos.title: Monarch Sunset Silhouette
photos.caption: A monarch butterfly with orange and black wings rests on a tall, slender, dried plant stem against a vibrant sunset. The sky transitions from deep reddish-brown at the top to bright orange and yellow at the horizon, with dark, blurred clouds. Below the horizon, a dark, calm body of water reflects the sky's colors, and the foreground is a dark silhouette of land and sparse vegetation. A small logo with mountains and stars is in the bottom right corner.

photos.title: Desert Star Trails Campfire
photos.caption: A long-exposure photograph captures star trails arcing across a dark night sky above a desert landscape. On the left, a person sits in a camping chair by a bright campfire, looking up at the sky. Silhouetted rock formations rise in the background, and the warm glow of the fire illuminates the ground and a nearby reddish hill on the right.

photos.title: Jet under Milky Way
photos.caption: An old, weathered U.S. Air Force jet, possibly a Lockheed T-33 Shooting Star, sits on a dark, grassy hill under a brilliant night sky. The Milky Way galaxy is visible as a hazy band of countless stars stretching across the upper right. The jet is illuminated by an unseen light source, highlighting its metallic surface and the text 'U.S. AIR FORCE' on its side. The horizon glows with a faint reddish-orange light, possibly from distant light pollution or a sunset/sunrise.

photos.title: Tiger Shark Night
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph captures the weathered fishing trawler 'Tiger Shark Sandy Marie' at night. Its rusty hull and tall masts are illuminated against a dramatic, teal-blue sky filled with streaky clouds and faint stars, while calm water surrounds the boat and distant small islands are visible on the horizon.

photos.title: Bisti Badlands Concretions
photos.caption: A wide shot of a desolate, otherworldly desert landscape at twilight. In the foreground, numerous large, rounded, and broken rock formations with reddish-brown and beige striped patterns are scattered across the light gray ground, resembling giant petrified eggs or ancient, eroded shells. In the midground and background, more eroded hills, mesas, and smaller hoodoos rise under a sky that transitions from a warm orange-yellow on the left horizon to a deep purple-gray overhead.

photos.title: Abandoned Under Starlight
photos.caption: An old, rusty, olive-green sedan sits abandoned in a field of tall, vibrant green grass. The sky above transitions from a warm orange-red at the horizon to a deep, star-filled blue, with faint wispy clouds and a prominent bright star or planet. The scene evokes a serene and nostalgic mood of time passing.

photos.title: Starry Night Homestead
photos.caption: An abandoned, weathered wooden house and a rusty vintage car sit in a field of tall, dry grass under a vast, dark blue night sky teeming with countless bright stars. The dilapidated house, with its peeling paint and corrugated metal roof, glows with a soft yellowish light, while the heavily rusted car, missing its roof and windshield, has one headlight illuminated, casting an orange glow on its decaying body. The scene evokes a sense of desolation and timelessness under the expansive, star-filled cosmos.

photos.title: Cadillac Ranch Night
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph of Cadillac Ranch at night, showing ten graffiti-covered Cadillac cars buried nose-down in the ground, stretching from left to right across the frame. Bright red light trails, forming circles and swirls, emanate from the front of each car, suggesting light painting. The sky above is a deep indigo, filled with countless tiny stars. In the distance, a faint glow of city lights can be seen on the horizon, and the ground is dark, textured dirt.

photos.title: Starry Barn Glow
photos.caption: A rustic wooden barn glows from within at night, casting bright vertical light rays through its slatted walls and double doors onto the dark, reddish-brown ground. Above the illuminated structure, a vast, dark night sky is filled with countless stars, with a faint comet visible in the upper left. The scene evokes a mysterious and serene mood.

photos.title: Steel Wool Sparks Car
photos.caption: A long-exposure photograph captures a vibrant shower of golden sparks erupting from behind a copper-colored Dodge Challenger parked on a gravel ground at night. The sparks create a dramatic, fan-like pattern, illuminating the car and the surrounding industrial landscape, which includes a dark water tower and a train car in the background. The mood is energetic and dynamic.

photos.title: Huey Christmas Night
photos.caption: A dark night sky filled with numerous stars serves as the backdrop for a large, dark green Huey helicopter, seemingly in flight with its main rotor blades blurred from motion. Below and to the left of the helicopter, a brightly lit Christmas tree glows with warm white lights, adorned with a star on top and a few wrapped presents at its base. A metal fence runs horizontally behind the tree, and dark trees line the horizon in the distance. The overall mood is festive and somewhat surreal, blending military imagery with holiday cheer.

photos.title: UFO Night Landing
photos.caption: A long exposure night shot shows a weathered, rust-orange and teal flying saucer-shaped structure with glowing blue and green windows, landed in a field of tall grass under a dark, star-filled sky. A small set of stairs descends from an open hatch on the left side of the structure, which is illuminated from within by blue light. The horizon on the right glows with an orange light, suggesting light pollution or a distant city.

photos.title: Starry Archway Stream
photos.caption: A breathtaking vertical night landscape features a dark sky densely packed with stars and the Milky Way, with a faint meteor streak visible. A massive, rugged rock formation with a prominent natural arch is dramatically illuminated in warm orange light, contrasting with a dark, forested hillside. In the foreground, a stream flows over rocks, surrounded by lush green grass and vegetation.

photos.title: Starry Night Rocks
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light photograph captures a dark night sky filled with countless bright stars over a landscape of large, rugged rock formations and dry grasses. A prominent, tall, light brown rock stands on the right, while several smaller, similarly textured rocks are visible in the middle ground on the left. The foreground is dominated by dry, golden-brown grasses and additional rocks, all subtly illuminated, creating a serene and vast nocturnal scene.

photos.title: Red Bridge Night
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph captures a vibrant red metal truss bridge at night, with a weathered wooden walkway leading into the distance. Streaks of light from passing vehicles are visible through the bridge's structure on the right, contrasting with the dark, star-dusted sky above. The bridge's metal beams are covered in white graffiti, adding to its urban, slightly eerie mood.

photos.title: Through the Old Window
photos.caption: A view from a dark, rustic interior through an old, multi-paned window. Outside, a large, bare tree with intricate branches stands against a cloudy sky, overlooking a dry, grassy field with distant trees. The dark room features wooden walls and a weathered stone structure to the right, creating a somber and aged atmosphere.

photos.title: Abandoned Gas Station Night
photos.caption: An abandoned gas station sign spelling 'GAS' in red and white stands tall on the left, under a dark, star-filled night sky with a faint purple-blue hue. To its right, a rusty, corrugated metal canopy, supported by orange poles, covers an empty space. Behind the canopy and sign, a large, bare tree with light-colored branches dominates the center, surrounded by other dark, leafless trees and sparse ground vegetation. The overall mood is desolate and eerie.

photos.title: Night Sky Old Car
photos.caption: A wide-angle, long-exposure shot at night shows a starry sky above a field with a rusty, vintage car in the foreground. A large tree with bright green leaves stands to the left, illuminated by an unseen light source. In the background, a highway is visible with streaks of red and white light from passing vehicles, indicating movement.

photos.title: Bluebonnets and Stars
photos.caption: A wide-angle, long-exposure photograph captures a vibrant field of bluebonnets and yellow wildflowers under a dark, star-filled night sky. In the midground, the illuminated ruins of a brick building stand to the left, balanced by a large, majestic tree with green leaves on the right. The serene landscape combines natural beauty with historical remnants, bathed in the soft glow of the night.

photos.title: VLA Night Sky
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light photograph captures the Very Large Array (VLA) radio telescopes under a star-filled night sky. In the foreground, several large, white parabolic dishes stand tall against a dark, silhouetted horizon of distant hills. The ground is covered in dry, golden-brown grass, illuminated by an unseen light source, creating long shadows. The sky above is a deep indigo, densely populated with countless tiny, sparkling white and blue stars, with a faint glow visible towards the horizon.

photos.title: Prada Marfa at Dusk
photos.caption: A standalone, minimalist white building resembling a Prada store, labeled 'PRADA MARFA', stands illuminated in the middle of a desolate, rocky desert landscape at dusk. The store's windows display various high-heeled shoes and handbags, glowing warmly against the deep blue and purple hues of the twilight sky and the dark, barren ground. A single step leads up to the entrance, and a security camera is visible on the top left corner of the building.

photos.title: Starry Night Mine Ruins
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light photograph shows the ruins of an old mining operation under a brilliant starry night sky. A large, partially collapsed building of rusted corrugated metal and broken wooden beams is warmly illuminated in the foreground, standing on a rocky mound. To its right, a tall, dark, skeletal headframe is silhouetted against the deep blue-black sky, which is densely packed with countless white and blue stars, creating a scene of desolate beauty.

photos.title: VLA Under Stars
photos.caption: A wide-angle, long-exposure photograph captures the Very Large Array (VLA) radio telescopes under a brilliant, star-filled night sky. The foreground features a snowy, dark landscape with several large, white dish antennas, illuminated by warm, golden lights from below. The largest antenna dominates the left side, angled upwards, while a line of smaller antennas stretches into the distance on the right, silhouetted against a faint orange glow on the horizon.

photos.title: Stargazer in Cave
photos.caption: A person stands in a rocky cave, illuminated by a bright blue light from behind, casting their silhouette against the cave wall. The cave walls are a mix of warm orange and cool blue tones. Above the cave, a vast, dark night sky is filled with countless twinkling stars, with a few prominent star clusters visible.

photos.title: Moonlit Church and Ruin
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph taken at night shows a dirt road leading towards a small, white church with a dome-shaped steeple, nestled among dark trees in the distance. To the left, a brick building heavily overgrown with dark green ivy and vines stands partially obscured by tall grasses, its windows appearing as dark voids. The sky above is a deep indigo, dotted with numerous stars and streaked with faint, wispy clouds, suggesting a moonlit night.

photos.title: Starry Night Abandoned Building
photos.caption: A wide, nighttime photograph captures an abandoned white building and a large, bare tree under a vast, star-filled sky. The weathered building and the dense, leafless tree are illuminated with a warm, orange light, contrasting with the deep blue-green of the sky, which is densely packed with countless bright stars. A tall pole with a triangular top stands in front of the building, adding to the desolate and mysterious atmosphere of the scene.

photos.title: Starry Night Abandoned Farm
photos.caption: A wide, low-angle shot captures an abandoned, dilapidated wooden farmstead under a vast, dark indigo night sky filled with countless stars. Several decaying structures with collapsing roofs and bare, gnarled trees are surrounded by dry, golden-brown grass and old metal barrels in the foreground. The scene evokes a somber, historical mood of a forgotten rural landscape.

photos.title: Rusty Car Under Stars
photos.caption: A long exposure photograph taken at night shows a rusty, abandoned car in a field of dry grass under a dark blue sky filled with countless white stars. In the background, silhouetted trees and a dilapidated building are visible, with a faint glow of light pollution on the horizon to the right. The overall mood is one of solitude and decay.

photos.title: Red Lit Desert Church
photos.caption: A weathered, abandoned stone church with a cross atop its bell arch stands in a sandy, desert-like landscape under a dark, star-filled night sky. A striking red light emanates from its arched windows and open wooden door, creating an eerie glow against the crumbling facade. Dark hills rise in the background.

photos.title: Old Lodge Under Stars
photos.caption: An old, weathered two-story wooden building with a small cupola stands under a dark blue, star-filled night sky. A Masonic square and compass symbol with the year '1874' is visible on the gable. A wooden picket fence encloses the foreground, while tree-covered hills rise in the background, all softly illuminated.

photos.title: Desert Night Sky
photos.caption: A wide-angle, long-exposure shot captures a clear, star-filled night sky over a desolate landscape. In the foreground, a large, bare tree with bright, illuminated branches stands prominently, its trunk and lower branches glowing with a warm light. To the right of the tree, an old, dilapidated building with a single window emits a warm, orange glow, suggesting an interior light source. Further back and to the left, another smaller, darker structure is partially visible. The ground is covered in sparse, dry vegetation and what appears to be a broken wooden fence. A utility pole and power lines are visible on the far left, and a faint glow on the horizon suggests distant light pollution or a rising moon. The overall mood is serene yet slightly eerie, highlighting the vastness of the night sky against human structures.

photos.title: Starry Night Porch
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light photograph taken from a wooden porch looking out onto a rural landscape under a starry night sky. The porch, made of dark wood planks and supported by rough-hewn posts, extends from a rustic wooden building on the left. In the foreground, a rock and a rolled-up mat are on the porch floor. Beyond the porch, a dirt road leads to a small, old-fashioned house with a stone chimney and a bare tree with sprawling branches to its right. The sky is a deep indigo, dotted with numerous white stars, and a faint glow from the horizon suggests distant light pollution.

photos.title: Rustic Night Sky
photos.caption: A wide-angle night photograph captures an old wooden mining wheel and a small log cabin with wagon wheels in a forest clearing. Warm artificial light illuminates the weathered structures and the bare trees, contrasting with the deep blue, star-filled sky above.

photos.title: Abandoned Motel Night Sky
photos.caption: An abandoned motel with a rusty 'MOTEL' sign stands under a clear, star-filled night sky. Overgrown trees and bushes partially obscure the dilapidated building, which has a corrugated metal roof and a visible chimney. The foreground shows dry grass and dark ground, illuminated by a faint, warm light, creating a mysterious and eerie mood.

photos.title: Starry Night Abandoned Building
photos.caption: A long-exposure night photograph captures an abandoned, two-story stone building under a vast, star-filled sky. The derelict building has empty window frames and two prominent chimneys, surrounded by sparse, dark vegetation. The deep black sky is densely populated with countless bright stars, some showing slight trails, creating an eerie and desolate mood.

photos.title: Abandoned Gas Station Night
photos.caption: An abandoned gas station at night under a starry sky. A tall, vertical sign with red borders and white letters spells 'GAS' on the left. To the right, a rusty, corrugated metal canopy stands on two orange poles. Behind the canopy, a large, bare tree with light-colored bark and a few brown leaves is illuminated. In the background, a dark forest line is visible, with some trees showing faint light. The sky is a deep indigo, dotted with numerous stars and a few faint clouds. The overall mood is serene and slightly melancholic.

photos.title: Ivy-Covered Ruins at Night
photos.caption: A dark, vertical photo shows an old stone wall, heavily overgrown with vibrant green ivy on the left side. Through an opening in the wall, a grassy field is visible, illuminated by a faint glow, with a large tree standing in the distance. Above the wall, a clear night sky is filled with numerous tiny stars.

photos.title: Desert Night Church
photos.caption: An old, stone church with a white picket fence stands under a starry night sky, next to a dilapidated yellow building with a corrugated metal roof. The scene is illuminated by an unseen light source, casting long shadows and highlighting the textures of the weathered buildings and sparse vegetation. The mood is serene yet slightly eerie, with the vastness of the night sky contrasting with the humble, abandoned structures.

photos.title: Night Sky Abandoned Homestead
photos.caption: A wide shot of a dark night sky filled with numerous stars, above an old, dilapidated wooden shack and a rusty, abandoned car. The shack is on the left, partially obscured by bare trees and dry, tall grass. The car, a vintage model, is on the right, mostly hidden by dense, thorny bushes and more dry grass. The overall mood is one of quiet desolation under a vast, starry expanse.

photos.title: Starry Night Abandoned House
photos.caption: A nighttime landscape features an old, yellowish house with a corrugated roof and dark windows, nestled between two large, bare trees with intricate branches. Above, a dark blue sky is densely populated with countless white and blue stars. Warm light subtly highlights the house, the trees, and the dry grass in the foreground, creating a mysterious and desolate atmosphere.

photos.title: Window to Winter Trees
photos.caption: A view from inside a dark, rustic room looking out through a multi-paned window. Outside, a large, bare-branched tree dominates the frame against a cloudy sky, with a field of dry grass and more distant trees visible below. To the right, a rough-hewn stone wall is partially visible, suggesting an old or abandoned structure.

photos.title: Abandoned Gas Station Night
photos.caption: An eerie night shot of an abandoned gas station and general store. Two rusty, vintage gas pumps stand in the foreground, with the one on the right displaying 'UNLEADED GASOLINE' and a price of '49 9/10 CENTS PER GALLON'. The dilapidated general store behind them has a faded sign that reads 'W.S. F____ GENERAL MERCHANDISE'. Overgrown weeds and dry brush surround the pumps and the building, adding to the desolate, forgotten mood. The dark night sky looms above, with a bare tree silhouetted against it on the left.

photos.title: Rusty Relics Under Stars
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light photograph captures a desolate, abandoned gas station at night under a deep blue, star-dusted sky. Two heavily rusted, orange gas pumps with exposed internal mechanisms flank a similarly rusted, dark vintage car missing a wheel, all sheltered beneath a dark, corroded metal canopy. The skeletal concrete shell of a building stands behind them, while dry, tall grass and bare trees frame the eerie, forgotten scene.

photos.title: Abandoned Homestead Night Sky
photos.caption: An old, dilapidated wooden house and a rusty, abandoned car sit in a field of tall grass under a brilliant, star-filled night sky. The house is weathered with peeling paint and a corrugated metal roof, while the car, possibly a vintage model, has a single headlight glowing faintly. The overall mood is one of serene desolation, with the vast expanse of stars contrasting with the earthly decay.

photos.title: Starry Jailhouse
photos.caption: A small, ancient-looking stone building with a heavy barred door stands under a vast, star-filled night sky. A prickly pear cactus grows on its roof, and the structure is illuminated by a warm, orange light, highlighting its rough texture against the deep blue and purple hues of the cosmos. Bare trees are silhouetted in the distant background, adding to the desolate and historical mood of the scene.

photos.title: Starry Night Cabin
photos.caption: A wide-angle shot of a rustic wooden cabin under a dark, star-filled night sky. The cabin has a front porch with pillars and a rusty metal roof, with a stone chimney on the right side. A large, bare-branched tree stands prominently to the right of the cabin, its dark silhouette reaching towards the sky. The ground in the foreground is a mix of dark grass and reddish-brown dirt, with a faint glow of light pollution visible on the horizon.

photos.title: Bond Street Dead End
photos.caption: A nighttime photo shows a 'Bond St.' street sign and a 'Dead End' sign on a dirt road, leading to an old, dilapidated wooden house surrounded by dry brush and trees. The sky above is a deep blue, filled with countless bright stars, creating a serene yet slightly eerie atmosphere.

photos.title: Abandoned Church Night Sky
photos.caption: An old, weathered wooden church with a tall, square bell tower stands under a dark, star-filled night sky. The church's exterior is illuminated by a warm, golden light, highlighting its faded white and brown planks, while the surrounding landscape is dark with faint light pollution on the horizon. The mood is serene and slightly melancholic.

photos.title: Church Under Milky Way
photos.caption: A long-exposure photograph captures a brick church with a tall steeple and cross under a dark, star-filled night sky. The faint, luminous band of the Milky Way galaxy is visible stretching across the upper right, with stars appearing as subtle trails due to the long exposure. The church's facade and roof are softly illuminated, creating a serene and majestic scene.

photos.title: Starry Night Ruin
photos.caption: A wide-angle, low-light photograph shows an old, dilapidated single-story building under a vast, star-filled night sky. The weathered building has a partially collapsed roof, exposed wooden beams, and several empty or boarded-up window frames, with dry, golden-brown grass in the foreground.
